game.title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord (DOS)

Title monster parade: three monsters under the logo

"Now loading the program into memory ..." while the game loads
Castle on a fresh start: no party yet, the party window is empty
Training Grounds: create, inspect, roster of characters, leave
Creation: "Enter a name for your character", ZED typed
Creation: a name already on the roster - "Name already in use"
Creation: "Enter password" (may be left empty)
Creation: choose race - human, elf, dwarf, gnome, hobbit
Creation: choose alignment - good, neutral, evil (elf chosen)
Creation: elf base statistics and 9 bonus points to share
Bonus points: STR 11, IQ 11, AGI 11 open fighter, mage and thief
Select class: fighter, mage or thief for the neutral elf
Mage chosen: "Keep this character (Y/N)?"
Training Grounds, a character: inspect, delete, change class, password
The new character's sheet: ZED, level 1 neutral elf mage, 180 gold

Cot: "RYZ is recuperating", hit points 5/8, gold 82 counting down
"You made the next level!": IQ, agility and luck up, vitality down, +3 HP
Temple of Cant: "Who shall we help?" with nobody in need
Edge of Town: training, maze, castle, utilities, leave game
Wizardry Utilities: change name, move characters, restart an "out" party

Boltac's Trading Post: "Who will enter?"

Boltac's stock, page 1: long sword 25 ... dagger 5

"Murmur - chant - pray - invoke! * CONDI has been healed *"
CONDI in ashes: the donation is 6500 (500 gold per level)

Floor 1 entrance: wireframe corridor, command line, party window

"DEDDO casts a HALITO" - the last slime already fell to the fighters
"Each survivor gets 36 E.P." after the fight
A chest! Open, Calfo, leave alone, inspect, disarm

"You disarmed the trap!"
